haneoka is an unofficial BanG Dream! Our Notes database and tool site maintained by fans. We sincerely thank everyone who has contributed to keeping the project running. Below is our list of supporters and their messages.

About Donations

All data, archives, and browser tools on haneoka are provided free of charge and without advertisements. As our database and media archives grow alongside game updates, maintaining the servers and storage infrastructure requires ongoing funding.

If you find haneoka useful, you are welcome to support the project through the channels on this page. Contributions go toward covering server and storage expenses, helping us continue compiling game data and improving our tools.

We extend our sincere gratitude to all current and past supporters for your generosity and encouragement.
